name: walk_turn
description: Walk, and turn in place at the commanded rate (wobble tax off: 0.5 rad/s at gain 1.17-1.23). Loads into the walk slot; the factory walk policy is a different repo.

command.twist: [vx, vy, wz] = the daemon's velocity command. This build is the turn-fixed one: it tracks |wz| = 0.5 rad/s at gain 1.17-1.23 and matches the current walk policy on the walk row.
